Name: HeartBloom - Heart Event Lookup
Author: HoangTuDaa18
Description:
[center][img width=343]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/55446/55446-1795327544-1813016298.png[/img][/center]
[b][color=#d5a6bd]HeartBloom[/color][/b] is a quality-of-life mod that lets you discover, browse, and track NPC Heart Events directly from Stardew Valley's Social tab.
It places small heart icons next to NPC names so you can see at a glance who has available events and which ones you've unlocked based on your current friendship levels.
With a dedicated Event Details interface, [b][color=#d5a6bd]HeartBloom[/color][/b] goes beyond basic tracking. You can inspect Event IDs, friendship requirements, locations, time windows, and extra conditions—making it easy to see how different events connect.
[color=#d5a6bd][b]HeartBloom[/b][/color] doesn't add new events, alter existing ones, or trigger them automatically. It simply gives you a clean, intuitive way to explore the Heart Events already in your game.

[img width=325]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/55446/55446-1794497367-777205758.png[/img]
[center][img width=360]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/55446/55446-1795328125-432203469.png[/img][/center]
[*][b][color=#ff7700]Heart Indicators:[/color][/b] Small heart icons appear next to NPC names whenever compatible Heart Events are available.[/*]
[*][b][color=#ff7700]Hover Tooltips:[/color][/b] Hover over a heart icon to preview your lowest-heart unseen event (once you meet its friendship requirement), complete with its location.[/*]
[*][b][color=#ff7700]Event List:[/color][/b] Click a heart icon to browse all available Heart Events, including their heart requirements, locations, and time windows.[/*]
[*][color=#ff7700][b]Event Details:[/b] [/color]Open a dedicated details view to inspect an event's ID, NPC requirements, location, completion status, and extra conditions.[/*]
[*][b][color=#ff7700]Clickable Event References:[/color][/b] Click on Event IDs referenced within conditions to jump straight to that event and trace event dependencies effortlessly.[/*]
[*][b][color=#ff7700]Event Navigation:[/color][/b] Easily step back to previously viewed events while exploring linked Event IDs.[/*]
[*][b][color=#ff7700]Seen Event Tracking:[/color][/b] Clearly distinguish between events you've already watched and ones you haven't.[/*]
[*][b][color=#ff7700]Hide Seen Events:[/color][/b] Toggle off watched events to keep your event list clean and focused.[/*]
[*][b][color=#ff7700]Additional Conditions:[/color][/b] View extra requirements such as weather, mail, story progression, dialogue choices, and other game flags.[/*]
[*][color=#ff7700][b]Multiplayer Support:[/b] [/color]Each player can independently browse and inspect Heart Events based on their own friendship levels and event progress.[/*]
[*][b][color=#ff7700]Event Replay:[/color][/b] Rewatch previously seen Heart Events simply by clicking their heart icon in the event list.[/*]
[*][b][color=#ff7700]Mod Compatibility:[/color][/b] Works seamlessly with compatible Heart Events added by custom NPC and location mods.[/*]
[*][b][color=#ff7700]Spoiler-Free:[/color][/b] Events only become visible once you've met their friendship requirements.

[img width=485]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/55446/55446-1794725748-533727595.png[/img]
[center][img width=361]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/55446/55446-1795328147-585665623.png[/img][/center]
[/*]
[*][color=#d5a6bd][b]HeartBloom [/b][/color]only checks friendship requirements to determine which events are shown. Other conditions are listed for reference and aren't all evaluated automatically.[/*]
[*]Event ID links are only clickable when[color=#d5a6bd][b] HeartBloom[/b][/color] can pinpoint a single target event and confirm you meet its friendship requirement.[/*]
[*]Event browsing in multiplayer is completely independent per player. Replaying an event won't pull other players into the cutscene.[/*]
[*]Replaying events may re-apply rewards or item changes, and certain event commands can affect shared NPC or world states.[/*]
[*]Some host-specific events cannot be replayed by farmhands.


[center][img width=360]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/55446/55446-1795328164-1278559777.png[/img][/center]
Check the Changelog for the latest fixes and improvements. Huge thanks to everyone using HeartBloom, reporting bugs, and sharing feedback to help make the mod better. Your support truly means a lot!
[center][img width=371]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/55446/55446-1795328182-1392561976.png[/img][/center]
[b]How?[/b]
[list]
[*][b][color=#ff7700]Install SMAPI (version 4.0.0 or later)[/color][/b] if you haven't already.[/*]
[*][b]Download [color=#d5a6bd]HeartBloom[/color] [/b]and extract the downloaded ZIP file.[/*]
[*]Move the
[code]HeartBloom[/code]folder into your Stardew Valley
[code]Mods[/code]folder.[/*]
[*]Launch Stardew Valley through [color=#ff7700][b]SMAPI.[/b][/color][/*]
[/list][b]Optional:[/b]
[list]
[*]Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098][b]Generic Mod Config Menu (GMCM)[/b][/url] to configure HeartBloom directly in-game.[/*]
[/list]That's it! [b][color=#d5a6bd]HeartBloom[/color][/b] is ready to use.
[b]Note:[/b] Make sure the folder structure looks like this:
[code]Stardew Valley/
└── Mods/
